Ticker desk · for your approval · 2026-10-16 · not shipped

Before → after: the desk's visual hierarchy

Real captures of the running desk on both builds, before and after the build round's hierarchy pass. The boards in this row are redrawn to match the after. Approve it, or say what to change; nothing ships until you do.

  1. First read: the price and the structure verdict (staging), or the ticker and TradingView's chart (production).
  2. Second: the levels that frame it: the field with the flip and walls, the ladder's distances, the move options price.
  3. Third: supporting context: the read strip, the AI read, the tape and the book, then a quieter context band.

Where the first read lands

Top of each element in CSS pixels on the staging desk (SPY). Before read off the captures; after measured in the browser.

Staging desk · 1280 · dark

  • Price first. The tabs move into the masthead and the sample-basis box moves under the desk as “About this sample”. The price carries its day change (▼ −0.13 from the scenario's prior close), and a neutral chip “+γ long gamma above 683.92” replaces the green “positive gamma” chip, so the sign never rides on hue alone.
  • The main chart states its finding (“Dealers are long gamma (+γ): spot 690.62 sits 1.0% above the 683.92 flip”). Its legend draws the flip as the chart does, not amber, and Regime and Implied move fill the empty space beside the ladder.
  • A one-line read strip: each value is the figure alone; its qualifier leads the caption.
  • The AI read earns its column (7/5 split). The sample read sets a watch level, checked against the snapshot, so it shows the trace line; the “Variant fingerprint” line is gone.
  • A quieter context band that points back at the levels: the straddle leads, titled by its finding, as a range bar against both walls. The disabled filter and the “+ Add widget” ghost are removed; neither did anything.
  • Per-symbol sample values: Net DEX, Vol/OI, IV skew and off-exchange share now differ by symbol, derived from each symbol's own sample data.

Production desk · 1280 · dark

  • Present before absent. The SEC panels move up beside TradingView's chart; FINRA's two Off cards fold into one Off card after them, with your reason.
  • The feed zone states its cause once (“Off because …”) instead of on every panel; each panel keeps its Not live tag, what it would show and “See it on the demo →”, in full rows. The page is 2,687 px tall at 1280, down from 3,221.

These captures ran on a local API without the SEC agent, so their SEC cards read Not set up; production has SEC set, as the Production board draws.
